rows.en: Yahoo! Here we go!
Flying out with you ain't bad.
Hey, afterwards I'll teach you about Culture.
rows.notes: Heard 'ato de bunka shusei'; guessed from clip 371.

rows.en: Hey, don't you dare die a dog's death.
Come back alive! That's an order!
Heh heh heh. You're no use at all.
There won't be a next time. Watch yourself.
You laid hands on my prey!
rows.notes: Heard 'te o tsuke atte'; read as 'te o dashi yagatte'.

rows.en: All right, on to the next op!
Looks like it's over.
That wasn't enough for me.
That was fine flying. I like you.
Hell of a fun op, wasn't it?
I'm counting on you next time too.
Right, heading home!
Not bad, for a woman.
rows.notes: Explicit in the line; this clip plays for a female partner.

rows.en: When we get back, I'll teach you about Culture.
Hey, give my best to Claudia, will you?
Skull Leader to all units. You heard it. We're switching to Intercept Formation 17. Got that?
War again, huh? It's been a while.
Anyone know where VT-102 went?
Glad I made it in time.
rows.notes: Heard 'osou ka yokatta'; read as 'ma ni atta ka'.

rows.en: You all right over there?
You can die for all I care, but save the girl!
rows.notes: Addressed to a pilot; the girl is not named.

rows.en: Damn, they're so quick, not like on the ground!
So this is the Macross transformation!
All right, you greenhorns, I'll take you on.
I'm looking forward to that pineapple salad.
I'm fine. Returning to base now.
Even if I'd been drinking, this'd be a piece of cake!
Well done.
Not bad at all!
rows.notes: Heard 'yaru ze nee ka'; read as 'yaru jan ka'.

rows.en: I'll go out myself.
Launching!
Now then, shall I go stir things up?
Not on my watch!
This is...

rows.notes: Heard 'goshaka'; probably a hit grunt. No safe reading.

rows.en: W-what?!
What is this power?!
I won't let you get away!
Fool!
Vrlitwhai, moving out.
rows.notes: Heard 'renchuu doudou'; guessed 'Vrlitwhai, commencing the mission' from other pilots' 100 lines.

rows.en: A fine chance to test our strength.
rows.notes: Heard 'wareware ni tamesu to wa'; read as 'tamesu ni wa ii joukyou'.

rows.en: Good! Begin the operation!
There!
You can't escape.
I won't let you get away!
You've sharpened your skills, haven't you.
rows.notes: Heard 'ne o ageru'; read as 'ude o ageru'.

rows.en: Tenacious.
Still want to fight?
Too fragile.
Hardly a challenge.
Is that all?
So you've shown yourself.
Come at me and I'll cut you down!
Hm? You want to fight?
Is that the best you can do?
Target destroyed.
Hm? My shield? Well, no matter.
My shield is gone.
This is nothing. I'm made differently from you lot.
A mere scratch!
Fools!
